diffusion.title: Optimization Benchmark for Diffusion Models on Dynamical Systems
diffusion.selection: Four explicitly selected configurations, three seeds each. Not a new exhaustive hyperparameter sweep.
diffusion.time_semantics: epoch_train_time excludes eval_time, which is missing in some logs. Full job duration also includes other overhead.
diffusion.metric_semantics: Validation denoising loss, not a perceptual or image-quality score.

tabular.title: Benchmarking Optimizers for MLPs in Tabular Deep Learning
tabular.selection: MLP AdamW and Muon on all 17 datasets, ten seeds per configuration.
tabular.comparability: Joint model and optimizer tuning; selected architectures can differ. Endpoint reports are not learning curves.
tabular.metric_semantics: Use native per-dataset metric. Do not convert RMSE to money or minutes without verifying the dataset target units.
